name: @tencentcloud/sdk-mcp

tools.name: present_framework_choice
tools.description:
Purpose:
Collect platform/framework choice from user when the question requires client-side platform context.

When to call (MUST):
- User asks API/component/feature/client troubleshooting/integration guidance but does not specify platform.
- search_trtc_knowledge returns needs_framework.
- User requests explicit codegen/integration but platform is not specified.

When NOT to call:
- Cross-platform product topics: pricing, product package, console-level product config.
- Server-side topics: REST API, webhook, UserSig principle.
- Platform is already explicitly provided by user.

Boundary:
- This tool only collects platform/framework; it does NOT return documentation content.
- After user chooses platform:
  - Q&A / troubleshooting / doc lookup -> call search_trtc_knowledge with product + frameworks.
  - Explicit codegen request -> call corresponding get_*_integration tool.

Few-shot:
- User: "Chat UIKit 怎么集成？" (no React/Vue) -> CALL present_framework_choice
- User: "CallKit 来电铃声怎么设置？" (no platform) -> CALL present_framework_choice
- User: "TIMPush 厂商通道怎么在控制台开通？" -> DO NOT call present_framework_choice

product.description: Target product. Allowed: chat | call | live | room | rtcengine | native_trtc_sdk | push.

tools.name: get_usersig
tools.description:
Purpose:
Generate a test userSig using SDKAppID and secretKey from MCP environment variables, for IM/TRTC local debugging.

When to call (MUST):
- User explicitly asks to generate userSig for a specific userID.
- User needs a test credential for IM/TRTC local integration debugging.

When NOT to call:
- User asks about userSig principles, production signing architecture, or security design.
- User does not provide a concrete userID yet.

Common trigger lexicon:
- 生成 userSig, 测试凭证, 本地联调凭证, userID 对应 userSig, IM 登录凭证, TRTC 登录凭证

Inputs:
- userID

Outputs:
- content: [{ type: 'text', text: userSig result or error details }]

Boundaries:
- This tool is for test credential generation only.
- Production should use server-side signing.
- If required environment variables are missing, return configuration guidance.

userID.description: Target userID for Tencent Cloud app login.

tools.name: search_trtc_knowledge
tools.description:
Purpose:
Use this tool as the default retrieval entry for Tencent RTC documentation and troubleshooting.

When to call (MUST):
- Technical Q&A: product capability, configuration, best practice, documentation lookup.
- API lookup: API / component / event / parameter / error code.
- Troubleshooting: error, exception, failure, compatibility issue.
- Integration reference lookup when user wants guidance/docs but does NOT explicitly ask for runnable code generation.

When NOT to call:
- Non-technical chat/greeting/small talk.
- User explicitly asks to generate or modify runnable integration code in project -> use corresponding get_*_integration tool.

Hard input rule:
- prompt MUST preserve original user question verbatim. Do NOT expand, rewrite, or inject extra assumptions.

Product routing:
- push: TIMPush / 推送 / 厂商 / FCM / APNs / 华为 / 小米 / OPPO / vivo
- chat: 会话 / TUIKit / IM / 主题
- call: CallKit / 通话
- live: LiveKit / 直播 / 语聊房
- room: RoomKit / 会议
- rtcengine: Web TRTC / WebRTC
- native_trtc_sdk: TRTCCloud / Native SDK / 客户端
- Multi-domain is allowed (e.g. ["push","chat"]).

Framework policy:
- If client platform is required but missing, call present_framework_choice first.
- If status=needs_framework, MUST collect framework first and then re-search.
- Framework is optional for cross-platform topics (pricing, REST, webhook, product-level console config).

Types policy:
- Default: do not pass types.
- Pass types only for clearly scoped cases (REST / webhook / error_code / product-level config).
- For discovery/listing questions (e.g. “有哪些组件/API”), keep types empty to avoid over-filtering.

Few-shot:
- User: "TRTC 报错 10015 是什么原因？" -> CALL search_trtc_knowledge
- User: "RoomKit 有哪些可配置组件？" -> CALL search_trtc_knowledge
- User: "帮我把 Web Chat UIKit 接进 React 项目并给可运行代码" -> Prefer get_*_integration (not this tool first)

Return contract:
- Returns status/confidence/fragments/meta.references/queryID/answer_contract.
- Before final user reply, MUST call finalize_answer.
- After explicit follow-up feedback, MUST call submit_feedback.

prompt.description: Original user question, MUST be passed verbatim. Do not rewrite or extend. Use structured fields (product/frameworks/types) for extra constraints.

product.description: Product array: chat|call|live|room|push|rtcengine|native_trtc_sdk. Infer and pass when confident. push has priority for TIMPush/推送 queries.

frameworks.description: Framework/platform array: react|vue|web|miniprogram|android|ios|flutter|c++|uni-app|harmonyos|react-native|unity|unreal-engine|donut. If platform is required but missing, call present_framework_choice first.

queryID.description: First call can be empty string; all subsequent calls in same consultation MUST reuse the returned queryID.

types.description: Optional filter. Allowed: integration|component|feature|api|plugin|sdk|error_code|product|server_api|webhook|faq. Keep empty for discovery/listing queries.

tools.name: finalize_answer
tools.description:
Purpose:
Finalize the answer in current consultation and return the follow-up text.

When to call (hard rule):
- Call exactly once after all searches are done and final answer is ready.
- MUST be called before replying final answer to user.
- Do NOT call for drafts, intermediate reasoning, or unfinished retrieval.

Input contract:
- prompt: original user question, consistent with search_trtc_knowledge prompt.
- answer: final user-facing answer text.
- queryID: REQUIRED, non-empty queryID from search_trtc_knowledge.
- product/framework: reuse values from the same consultation chain when available.

Output contract:
- Return follow-up text and append it as-is after answer.
- Do NOT write custom follow-up wording.

prompt.description: Original user question. Must match search_trtc_knowledge prompt.

answer.description: Final synthesized answer, same content sent to user.

product.description: Reuse product from current search_trtc_knowledge chain when available.

framework.description: Reuse framework from current search_trtc_knowledge chain when available.

queryID.description: REQUIRED. Non-empty queryID returned by search_trtc_knowledge.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description:
Purpose:
Submit user feedback for the finalize_answer follow-up.

When to call (hard rule):
- If previous assistant message ended with finalize_answer follow-up, inspect the next user reply first.
- If reply explicitly indicates solved/unsolved, MUST call this tool before any normal response.
- Do NOT call for unclear replies, unrelated new questions, or non-feedback messages.

Resolved mapping:
- resolved="1": Yes / 已解决 / 解决了 / 好的 / 谢谢 / OK / resolved
- resolved="0": No / 未解决 / 没解决 / 不行 / 还有问题 / still not working

Input contract:
- prompt: original user question, consistent with finalize_answer.
- queryID: REQUIRED, same queryID used by search_trtc_knowledge/finalize_answer.
- resolved: "1" or "0".

Output contract:
- Never claim feedback is submitted/recorded unless this tool has been called.

prompt.description: Original user question. Must match finalize_answer prompt.

framework.description: Reuse framework from current search_trtc_knowledge chain when available.

resolved.description: "1" for positive feedback, "0" for negative feedback.

- Chat (IM), Call, Live, Room, Push (TIMPush), Web TRTC (rtcengine), Native TRTC SDK.
- Applies to FAQ, error codes, APIs, SDK usage, component usage, integration references, and troubleshooting.

Product routing (infer product array before calling search_trtc_knowledge whenever possible):
- TIMPush / 推送 / 厂商通道 / FCM / APNs / 华为 / 小米 / OPPO / vivo -> ["push"]
- 会话 / TUIKit / ChatKit / IM 组件 / 主题定制 -> ["chat"]
- CallKit / 通话 -> ["call"]; 直播 / 语聊房 / LiveKit -> ["live"]; RoomKit / 会议 -> ["room"]
- TRTC Web SDK / rtcengine / WebRTC 插件 -> ["rtcengine"]
- TRTCCloud / Native SDK / 客户端 -> ["native_trtc_sdk"]
- If both push and IM are involved -> ["push", "chat"]
- If product cannot be inferred confidently, ask a brief clarification. Do not jump to web_search.

Framework policy:
- If search_trtc_knowledge returns needs_framework, call present_framework_choice first, then search again.
- See search_trtc_knowledge description for detailed framework decision rules.

queryID propagation rules (hard requirement):
- First search_trtc_knowledge call: queryID can be empty; server response includes generated queryID.
- Every subsequent search_trtc_knowledge / finalize_answer / submit_feedback call: MUST include that same queryID.
- Missing queryID is treated as a new consultation and breaks CLS linkage.
